evidence.claim_span: Folldal Gruver er et aktivt museum med utstillinger, merkede

summary.text: STIFTELSEN FOLLDAL GRUVER is a foundation registered in Folldal, founded 1988-06-29. STIFTELSEN FOLLDAL GRUVER works to preserve the facilities, buildings and equipment from the mining industry in Folldal and to spread knowledge about mining culture. It also collects, registers, secures and documents materials and objects from Folldal Verk AS and organisations linked to mining in Folldal, and makes the history available to others. Its main industry code is 91.220: historical site and monument activities. The register shows 16 employees and 2 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 5 941 933 NOK and the annual result was 107 415 NOK; operating income was down from 6 249 902 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 499 699 NOK in 2024 to 107 415 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 643 844 NOK in 2024 to 751 259 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is folldalgruver.no. The registered employee count went from 13 on 2025-12-13 to 16 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
